newsitem.title: KENYA: Prices low for all grades of Kenya coffee.
newsitem.headline: Prices low for all grades of Kenya coffee.

text.p: Coffee prices at the Nairobi auction were low on Tuesday for the second week running, auction officials said.

"Cup qualities in the premium grades just aren't there so prices have come down in the last two weeks," said a coffee dealer, adding that drought had ruined the quality of the premium AA and AB grades.
The Coffee Board of Kenya sold 20,237 of the 20,501 60-kg bags on offer, compared with its sale of 20,342 bags of the 20,767 on offer last week.
